notes.title: Free Update - Coming Soon for Nice Day for Fishing! 🎣
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers! 👋

Today at Gamescom, we made [b]two big announcements... 👀[/b]

[h2]Free Content Update - Coming Soon![/h2]
First up, we're excited to announce that a Nice Day for Fishing Content Update is coming soon to Steam, with many new additions to our Fishing RPG game set in the Epic NPC Man world!

[previewyoutube=8Sf2CLkSnm8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Free Content Update will bring:[/h3]

[b]❄️ Seasonal Events to explore
💪 Elite Enemies to find and fight
⛵ New Sails to equip on your boat
💨 Speed increase for your boat
➕ And more![/b]

Oh... and it will be [b]completely FREE![/b] 💙❤️ 

We hope you're looking forward to our future Content Update on Steam. We're excited to share even more details around the update with you all soon!

[h2]🟢 Xbox Announcement[/h2]
We've heard your comments and are thrilled to also announce that Nice Day for Fishing will arrive on Xbox Series X|S in 2025!

[previewyoutube=mj7C3em7z48;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What a day! We hope you're excited with our two announcements, but for now... Portal AWAYYYY! 🌀[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393160/Nice_Day_for_Fishing/

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Out Now for Nice Day for Fishing!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey there adventurers! 👋[/b]

We're back again with another patch for Nice Day for Fishing on Steam 🤝 

Let us [b]introduce you to Patch 1.1.0, which brings more improvements, bug fixes and the well requested addition of Portals across Azerim![/b]

[/p][h2]Portals in Azerim 🌀[/h2][p][b]Patch 1.1.0 is out now on Steam and one major addition in this update is Buildable Teleport Portals.[/b] There are four of these Portals, which you guessed it- you must build to use!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/72d5fd777088cf480ede9f453fe5ae92136ca6fe.png"][/img][/p][p][b]🏠 2 in Honeywood
⛱️ 1 at the Beach of Azerim
⚒️ 1 at the Undead Mines[/b]

These Portals allow for faster travel across the map, with the portals requiring you to dredge out some of the finest materials in our fishing game with your magnet hook.

We estimate that you'll be able to start unlocking these Portals in the last third of the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/e9fc2a0a448735ad7a95091c798f51fb11c1d9e3.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, if you've dredged up the Tinfoil Hat, the Ring of Mordor or the Company Property Necklace from our Legendary DLC, you'll want to re-equip them for a surprise we've added in this patch... 👀

We hope you enjoy this and the many other additions, tweaks and fixes that 1.1.0 has to offer... and [b]remember to shout 'Portal AWAYYYYY' as you enter those Portals[/b], adventurers! 😄 [/p][p][/p][h2]Please find our full Patch Notes for Patch 1.1.0 below:[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/d289de523e9784259174bdd5352d68753e4b73e8.png"][/img][/p][h2]Patch 1.1.0 - Patch Notes[/h2][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added four Teleport Portals:[/p][list][*][p]Two in the Town of Honeywood.[/p][/*][*][p]One at the Beach of Azerim.[/p][/*][*][p]One at the Undead Mines.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new inventory tabs and order.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to view baits in your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds for when collecting and equipping some Legendary DLC items.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Changes to the levelling up system, which players now shown their multiple levels ups when getting more exp than needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to the inventory slider when player has more than 25 items.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the stacking of status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to performance when collecting items.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements and adjustments to the Icon for the shift button.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the currents at the anchovy fish cave.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a save issue during the dark water scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues around saving whilst in cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bodger's Hammer would occasionally be missing when saving at the Hammer X quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the spawn position for the Wolf Fish to prevent it hanging on corners.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue around interaction speech indicators, which would occasionally remain incorrectly active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Baradun would occasionally be missing on a broken quest line when saving and quitting after getting the Holy Garlic.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Player Support[/h3][p]If you run into any issues with Nice Day for Fishing, please [url="https://team17.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-team17/contact-us/"]get in touch with our Support Team here![/url]

[/p][h3]Stay updated with our RPG Fishing Adventure ⬇️[/h3][p][url="https://x.com/EpicNPCManGame"]Follow Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing on X![/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/b2074b5073bc7ff713f91f256fb9a89f549bc020.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Enjoy the Portals, just as we do... Portal AWAYYYYY 🌀[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Out Now for Nice Day for Fishing!

This includes the option to reduce the flash screen effect which has been heavily requested by the community![/p][p][/p][p]Alongside this, our team have been hard at work squashing bugs that you've been reporting to us since launch! 🐛[/p][p][/p][p]This includes [b]a fix to the issue players were reporting regarding the continue game button in the main menu[/b], which wasn't working when some players attempted to boot up their save game for the first time. [/p][p][/p][p]With Patch 1.04, this issue is now fixed, and all players will be able to access their save game first time without the reboot of the game workaround. We want to thank you for your patience whilst we investigated and fixed this issue![/p][p][/p][h2]Future Gameplay Changes[/h2][p]We've also seen your [b]feedback regarding quests in Nice Day for Fishing[/b], task backtracking and some Steam reviews mentioning the repetitive nature of quests. you navigate across Azerim! 🌀[/p][p][/p][p]We'll discuss this addition and our changes more in our next Steam News post, but for now we want to say a massive thank you for all your support since Nice notes.title: Nice Day for Fishing is OUT NOW on Steam! 🎣
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 👋 We're thrilled to announce that...

[h2]Nice Day for Fishing is OUT NOW on Steam! 🎣[/h2]

Jump into Viva La Dirt League's Epic NPC Man world as Baelin the NPC Fisherman, exploring the waters of Azerim! When all adventurers in the town mysteriously vanish, you'll need to save Honeywood from something lurking in the deep... 👀

[previewyoutube=HfTtYuipDdE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]We hope you're excited to experience our fishing adventure RPG game today on Steam![/b]
[h2]Play Now: 👇[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393160/Nice_Day_for_Fishing/
[h3]Nice Day for Fishing - Key Features:[/h3]
[b]🗺️ Explore the Epic NPC Man world like never before:[/b] Explore the enchanting lands of Azerim above land and beneath the waves. Adventure through Honeywood Forest to the Azerim coast, where you'll encounter new quests, people to save and new fish to catch. 

[b]💥 Epic RPG fishing battles:[/b] Engage in fearless fishing battles to increase your strength and unlock spells to use against your aquatic adversaries. 

[b]❗ Ultimate Hero Experience:[/b] His rod is his weapon; his boat is his steed, and his hat is his armour. Every Adventurer deserves powerful tools for their quest!

[b]🎣 Complete your fishing collection:[/b] Prove yourself worthy to the mighty fishing God by offering completed collections from each region at his statue, and receive your blessings of upgraded skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/0c44731b35eea29d07796a4dcb1a25e2ce8a9b3d.gif[/img]
[h3]Player Support[/h3]
If you run into any issues with Nice Day for Fishing, please [url=https://team17.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-team17/contact-us/]get in touch with our Support Team here![/url]

[h3]Demo News[/h3]
We've just taken down the Steam demo for Nice Day for Fishing, with our indie team focusing on our full launch!

We appreciate all your demo feedback over the last months and are excited to see your reaction to Nice Day for Fishing now the game has launched on Steam! 🥳

[h3]Stay updated with our RPG Fishing Adventure ⬇️[/h3]
[url=https://x.com/EpicNPCManGame]Follow Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing on X![/url]

[url=https://x.com/EpicNPCManGame][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/b2074b5073bc7ff713f91f256fb9a89f549bc020.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.0 - OUT NOW! 🎣 Our demo is back on Steam with improvements!
notes.content:
[h3]Nice Day for a Demo update, ain't it? 😏[/h3]

Our Nice Day for Fishing Demo is back on Steam with a big update... [b]Adventurer, we hope you accept this quest to explore Honeywood in Demo Update 1.0![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300978/b8723a046ac923646d286a57a3f94f4847f76a26.png[/img]

Your overwhelming support during Steam Next Fest and beyond has been incredible! From your feedback around our first demo build, we've implemented changes, improvements and additions to make you have the best adventure possible as Baelin in our demo! 🎣

We'd also like to highlight one major addition, as we've added new localised languages to the demo. The demo now includes German, French, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese languages! 

Please read our patch notes below for a full list of demo additions, changes and improvements:

[h2]⚙️ Patch Notes Demo 1.10 ⚙️[/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[b]New Languages[/b]
[list][*] Added German, French, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese languages.[/list] [b]All Additions[/b][list][*] Added permanent attacking when holding the attack button.
[*] Added new voice line sound bites for all NPCs.
[*] Added a maximum level cap.
[*] Added new treasure chest visuals.
[*] Added consumable item status effect tool tips.
[*] Added a Next/Skip function for dialog lines.
[*] Added more detailed information during fish collection.
[*] Added more tutorials, including additional tutorials for movement and adjustments to existing tutorials for added clarity.
[*] Added new decorations to the world.

notes.title: Nice Day to Announce Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing, ain't it? 😏
notes.content:
Morning! Nice Day for Fishi-Fis- .... Let's try again!

Nice day to announce [b]Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing[/b], ain't it? 😏

Viva La Dirt League, Team17 & FusionPlay have teamed up to bring you the first official game set in Viva La Dirt League’s world of Azerim, Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing! 🎣 Watch our announcement trailer: https://youtu.be/bdB4ybcIfhs

We hope you're excited to explore the Epic NPC Man world in the upcoming Fishing-Adventure RPG! 🐟⚔️
[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[h3]🗺️ Explore the Epic NPC Man world like never before[/h3]
Explore the enchanting lands of Azerim above land and beneath the waves. Adventure through Honeywood Forest to the Azerim coast, where you'll encounter new quests, people to save and new fish to catch.
[h3]💥 Epic RPG fishing battles[/h3]
Engage in fearless fishing battles to increase your strength and unlock spells to use against your aquatic adversaries.
[h3]❗ Ultimate Hero Experience[/h3]
His rod is his weapon; his boat is his steed, and his hat is his armour. Every Adventurer deserves powerful tools for their quest!
[h3]🎣 Complete your fishing collection[/h3]
Prove yourself worthy to the mighty fishing God by offering completed collections from each region at his statue, and receive your blessings of upgraded skills.

Epic NPC Man Nice Day for Fishing arrives 2025 on Steam! Wishlist today 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393160/Epic_NPC_Man_Nice_Day_for_Fishing/
